headline: European Opzelura Approval in Atopic Dermatitis Could Be A Game Changer For Incyte (INCY)
summary: In July 2026, Incyte received European Commission approval for Opzelura (ruxolitinib) cream to treat moderate atopic dermatitis in adults who do not respond adequately to, or cannot use, topical corticosteroids and calcineurin inhibitors, supported by positive Phase 3 data showing improved symptoms, quality of life and tolerability. headline: Incyte (INCY) Wins EU Approval For Opzelura In Adult Moderate Atopic Dermatitis
summary: European Commission approves Opzelura (ruxolitinib) cream as the first steroid free topical JAK inhibitor for adults with moderate atopic dermatitis in the EU. Decision is based on Phase 3b TRuE AD4 data in adult patients with mild to moderate atopic dermatitis. Approval expands Opzelura's use in Europe and adds a new dermatology revenue opportunity for Incyte. For investors following Incyte, ticker NasdaqGS:INCY, this EU approval adds a fresh piece of news around its dermatology efforts...

headline: 1 Unpopular Stock That Deserves Some Love and 2 Facing Headwinds
summary: When Wall Street turns bearish on a stock, it’s worth paying attention. These calls stand out because analysts rarely issue grim ratings on companies for fear their firms will lose out in other business lines such as M&A advisory.
